defmodule JadedFrontendServer do
  @moduledoc """
  Production-ready Elixir frontend proxy server serving static assets
  and proxying API requests to backend on port 8000.
  Listens on 0.0.0.0:5000 for external access.
  """

  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug Plug.Logger
  plug Plug.Static,
    at: "/",
    from: "frontend",
    only: ~w(index.html style.css main.js favicon.ico)

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:json],
    pass: ["application/json"],
    json_decoder: Jason

  plug :dispatch

  get "/" do
    send_file(conn, 200, "frontend/index.html")
  end

  forward "/api", to: JadedAPIProxy

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Not Found"}))
  end
end

defmodule JadedAPIProxy do
  @moduledoc """
  Proxy module for forwarding API requests to Julia backend on port 8000
  """
  import Plug.Conn
  require Logger

  def init(options), do: options

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    backend_url = ""
    method = conn.method |> String.downcase() |> String.to_atom()
    
    {:ok, body, conn} = read_body(conn)
    
    headers = Enum.map(conn.req_headers, fn {k, v} -> {String.to_charlist(k), String.to_charlist(v)} end)
    
    Logger.info("Proxying #{method} #{backend_url}")
    
    case :httpc.request(method, {String.to_charlist(backend_url), headers, 'application/json', body}, [], []) do
      {:ok, {{_, status, _}, resp_headers, resp_body}} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type(get_content_type(resp_headers))
        |> send_resp(status, List.to_string(resp_body))
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Backend proxy error: #{inspect(reason)}")
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(502, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Backend unavailable", reason: inspect(reason)}))
    end
  end

  defp get_content_type(headers) do
    Enum.find_value(headers, "application/json", fn
      {'content-type', value} -> List.to_string(value)
      _ -> nil
    end)
  end
end

{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:inets)
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:ssl)

{:ok, _} = Plug.Cowboy.http JadedFrontendServer, [], 
  port: 5000, 
  ip: {0, 0, 0, 0},
  protocol_options: [idle_timeout: 60_000]

Process.sleep(:infinity)

defmodule JadedAPIProxy do
  import Plug.Conn
  require Logger

  def init(options), do: options

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    backend_url = ""
    method = conn.method |> String.downcase() |> String.to_atom()

      m when m in [:get, :head, :options, :delete] ->
        {String.to_charlist(backend_url), headers}

    end
    
    case :httpc.request(method, request, [], []) do
      {:ok, {{_, status, _}, resp_headers, resp_body}} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type(get_content_type(resp_headers))
        |> send_resp(status, List.to_string(resp_body))
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Backend proxy error: #{inspect(reason)}")
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(502, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Backend unavailable", reason: inspect(reason)}))
    end
  end

  defp get_content_type(headers) do
    Enum.find_value(headers, "application/json", fn
      {~c"content-type", value} -> List.to_string(value)
      _ -> nil
    end)
  end
end
